articles.title: Mail: Why does Prince William still refuse to wear a kilt during his visits to Scotland?

articles.title: Defence budget may grow 8–10% annually; execution key for defence stocks: Amit Anwani, PL Capital

articles.title: Show HN: Gemini-live-react – Real-time voice AI that works in the browser
articles.summary: Gemini Live, a real-time bidirectional voice AI, faces significant technical challenges for smooth browser operation. Key issues include audio sampling rate mismatches (16kHz input vs. browser's 44.1/48kHz), PCM16 endianness problems, and the critical trade-off between data buffering and achieving low latency. These complexities highlight the effort required to integrate advanced AI seamlessly into standard web environments, affecting user experience.
